flashcards.q: How is timeouts retries used in AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: Design for failure using timeouts, retries with backoff, idempotency keys, circuit breakers and fallbacks.

flashcards.q: What does AI Integration Architecture teach about chapter?
flashcards.a: This chapter is about those connections: how AI features are wired into the rest of a company's software, and how to design that wiring so it is reliable, secure, affordable and easy to change.

flashcards.q: What should be avoided with prompts in AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: **The model is a component, not the system.** It is tempting to design an AI feature around a single provider's model, with prompts, rules and data access all tangled into the calls to it.

flashcards.q: When is webhooks applied in AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: Explain how APIs, HTTP requests, authentication, webhooks and queues work, and when to use each.

flashcards.q: When should orchestration layer not be used in AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: Streaming improves how fast the system feels, but it complicates the architecture: the orchestration layer cannot check the whole answer against its rules before the user starts reading it.

flashcards.q: Where does king Academy come up in AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: The chapter closes with a field case from the Sales King Academy platform, where several small links in the architecture decided what users actually saw, and a lab on the live site.

flashcards.q: Where does october not apply in AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: 4. **Routing did not match the business model.** Also on 7 October, it was found that unpaid users had been served by the platform's most expensive model.

flashcards.q: Is decides whether always required in AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: In an AI integration, the architecture decides whether a model's output reaches the right place, whether a failure in one service brings down the rest, whether customer data is protected, and how much each request costs.

flashcards.q: Which approach to gateway fits AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: The request reaches the gateway, which checks the salesperson's login and passes the request on.

flashcards.q: Who is involved with king Academy in AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: Inspect the integration points of the Sales King Academy platform from the user's side.

flashcards.q: Who should not be handling malformed in AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: Codes in the 400s mean the request was at fault: 400 for a malformed request, 401 for missing or invalid credentials, 403 for a caller who is identified but not allowed, 404 for something that does not exist, and 429 for too many requests.

flashcards.q: Why does circuit breaker matter in AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: That is why retries must be combined with a circuit breaker (below) and a fallback, and why the retry count should be small.

flashcards.q: How is caching used in AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: Estimate and reduce the running cost of an AI integration through routing, caching and context control.

flashcards.q: What does AI Integration Architecture teach about cached?
flashcards.a: Decide where data lives, which system is the source of truth, and when answers may be cached.

flashcards.q: What should be avoided with meant in AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: GET requests are meant to be **safe**, meaning they do not change anything, so repeating them is harmless.

flashcards.q: When is tool calling applied in AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: Describe tool calling and the Model Context Protocol, and the controls needed when a model can take actions.

flashcards.q: When should retry not be used in AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: If someone tries to run all 5,000 requests at once from a script, most will be rejected with 429 errors, and without a queue and retry logic many summaries will simply be missing.

flashcards.q: Where does chat widget come up in AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: 1. **Clients.** The website, mobile app, chat widget, email inbox or internal tool where a person starts a request or sees a result.

flashcards.q: Which approach to requests fits AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: At 60 requests per minute, 5,000 requests take 5,000 ÷ 60 ≈ 83.33 minutes, or about 1 hour, 23 minutes and 20 seconds, at the very best.

flashcards.q: Who is involved with chat widget in AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: 1. **Clients.** The website, mobile app, chat widget, email inbox or internal tool where a person starts a request or sees a result.

flashcards.q: Who should not be handling orchestration layer in AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: Streaming improves how fast the system feels, but it complicates the architecture: the orchestration layer cannot check the whole answer against its rules before the user starts reading it.

flashcards.q: How is versioned used in AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: It assembles a prompt from a versioned template and sends it through the model layer to a chosen model.

flashcards.q: What does AI Integration Architecture teach about sales assistant?
flashcards.a: Most AI features in a business, from a sales assistant to an automated support reply, are built from the same set of parts.

flashcards.q: What should be avoided with malformed in AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: Codes in the 400s mean the request was at fault: 400 for a malformed request, 401 for missing or invalid credentials, 403 for a caller who is identified but not allowed, 404 for something that does not exist, and 429 for too many requests.

flashcards.q: When is outage applied in AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: When that provider changes its prices, deprecates a model or has an outage, everything has to be rebuilt.

flashcards.q: When should orchestration layer not be used in AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: Even so, the orchestration layer should **validate** every output against the schema before using it, and handle failures by retrying once or falling back, never by passing malformed data to the next system.

flashcards.q: Where does price list come up in AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: A draft email returned as fields (subject, body, any prices mentioned, any dates mentioned) can be checked field by field: every price must match the price list, every date must be a real date in the future.

flashcards.q: Which approach to timeouts retries fits AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: - hold the credentials for each provider; - translate a standard internal request into each provider's format; - choose which model to use for each request (routing); - apply timeouts, retries and fallbacks; - record usage, cost and latency for every call; - enforce limits per user, per customer and per feature.

flashcards.q: Who is involved with gateway in AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: 2. **Entry point or gateway.** The front door that receives requests, checks who is calling, applies rate limits and passes requests to the right handler.

flashcards.q: Who should not be handling reliability comes in AI Integration Architecture?
flashcards.a: Reliability comes not from preventing all failures but from handling them so that users are protected and data stays correct.
